out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils/Linens Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Observed that several pots were stored on the floor under a prep shelf.
violations.corrective_action: Store clean equipment, utensils, and linens in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. EHS INFORMED CFM TO RELOCATE OR REMOVE IF NOT USED.

out_items.name: Non-food contact surfaces clean

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: shelving in walk in cooler and exterior of packaged food containers.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the light shield in the dishwash area and ceiling tiles in certain areas are in poor repair.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: VARIOUS PLATES OBSERVED FOOD WORKER WASHING PLATES WITH SOAP AND WATER AND SETTING THEM ASIDE TO DRY.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. CDI: FOOD WORKER AND MANAGER RE-EDUCATED. ALL DISHES MUST BE WASHED, RINSED, AND SANITIZED. PLATES WERE CORRECTLY WASHED AND SANITIZED.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. CDI: SQUIRT BOTTLE LABELED DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.' PIC UNABLE TO PROVIDE EMPLOYEE HEALTH POLICY
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. CDI: EHS PROVIDED EMPLOYEE HEALTH POLICY AT TIME OF INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. CDI: EHS PROVIDED PROCEDURE AT TIME OF INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers used or stored in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils. OBSERVED AN EMPLOYEE DRINK ON PREP COUNTER IN KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: OBSERVED NO PAPER TOWELS PROVIDED AT HANDWASHING SINK AT BAR.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Shellstock Removed from Tagged or Labeled Container
violations.observation: Shellstock has been removed from the tagged/labeled container without preserving source identification. OBSERVED MUSSELS IN WALK IN COOLER WITHOUT IDENTIFICATION. OWNER STATED THEY WERE UNAWARE THEY REQUIRED TAGS.
violations.corrective_action: Shellstock that has been removed from the tagged/labeled container must have a system used to identify source. CDI: SHELLSTOCK DISPOSED OF AT TIME OF INSPECTION. REQUIREMENTS FOR SHELLSTOCK SENT TO OWNER.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED IN TWO-DOOR PREP UNIT ON FAR LEFT SIDE OF KITCHEN NEAR MICROWAVE: SPROUTS AT 55F, CUT LETTUCE AT 61F, COOKED PORK AT 46.7F. OBSERVED IN TABLE TOP COOLER IN ROOM ACROSS FROM BAR: SPROUTS AT 63.6F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: ALL TCS ITEMS THROWN AWAY DURING INSPECTION. CEASE HOLDING TCS FOODS ABOVE 41F. UTILIZE COLD HOLDING LOGS PROVIDED BY EHS.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: OBSERVED NO DATE MARKING IN FACILITY.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. OBSERVED MOUSE DROPPINGS COVERING STORAGE AREA THROUGH THE DOOR ADJACENT TO THE WALK-IN COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. PEST CONTROL SERVICE MUST OCCUR WITHIN TEN DAYS. OWNER STATED THEY WILL ARRIVE THIS EVENING. SEND EHS INVOICE. INCREASE YOUR PEST CONTROL SERVICE FREQUENCY.

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: OBSERVED FRONT DOOR OF FACILITY LEFT OPEN. OBSERVED BACK DOOR OF FACILITY CRACKED OPEN.
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. ALL DOORS MUST BE KEPT CLOSED UNLESS IN USE OR UTILIZING AN AIR CURTAIN OR SCREEN DOOR.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: OBSERVED GARLIC CONTAINERS REUSED FOR SPICES AND OTHER DRIED GOODS.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. CEASE USING GARLIC CONTAINERS AND REPLACE THEM WITH NSF APPROVED CONTAINERS OR THE EQUIVALENT.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Durable Materials
violations.observation: OBSERVED PLASTIC GROCERY BAGS BEING USED TO COVER FOODS IN COOLERS.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be resistant to pitting, chipping, crazing, scratching, scoring, distortion, and decomposition. CEASE USING PLASTIC GROCERY BAGS TO COVER OR CONTAIN FOODS. UTILIZE A FOOD SAFE MATERIAL.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: TWO-DOOR PREP TOP COOLER ADJACENT TO MICROWAVE IN THE LEFT OF THE KITCHEN; TABLETOP COOLER IN ROOM ACROSS FROM BAR
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. COOLERS MUST BE REPAIRED TO HOLD FOODS AT OR BELOW 41F WITHIN TEN DAYS. FOOD WITHIN COOLERS MUST BE REGULARLY MONITORED TO ENSURE IT IS HELD AT CORRECT TEMPERATURES. DO NOT HOLD ANY TCS FOODS IN COOLERS UNTIL THEY ARE REPAIRED.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a CHLORINE (BLEACH) test kit.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Covered Receptacle in Women's Toilet
violations.observation: There is no covered refuse container for the disposal of feminine napkins in the ladies room stall.
violations.corrective_action: A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. A COVERED TRASH OR RECEPTACLE MUST BE ADDED TO BOTH STALLS IN THE LADIES ROOM. LITTLE SAIGON RESTAURANT (Inspection Date: 06/30/2025) Page 3 of 4

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: OBSERVED THE SHELVES AND FLOOR IN THE DRY STORAGE AREA TO BE COVERED IN MOUSE DROPPINGS.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. THIS AREA MUST BE CLEANED. DO NOT USE ANY DISHES FROM THIS AREA UNTIL THEY ARE WASHED, RINSED, AND SANITIZED. ALL PACKAGES MUST BE INSPECTED FOR CHEWING AND THROWN AWAY IF IT SHOWS SIGNS OF PESTS. BEGIN CLEANING AT A HIGHER FREQUENCY.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands.

out_items.name: Approved thawing methods used

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: observed fish thawing in standing water in the 3 compartment sink
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. EMPLOYEE TURNED ON WATER.

out_items.name: Thermometers provided and accurate

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. PIC WILL PROVIDE EVIDENCE OF THE PURCHASE OF A FOOD THERMOMETER WITHIN 10 DAYS.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: observed utensils stored between equipment
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EMPLOYEE TOOK UTENSILS TO BE WASHED. LITTLE SAIGON RESTAURANT (Inspection Date: 12/18/2024) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a BLEACH test kit.
